sources.document: Battery Cell-to-Pack Scaling Trends for Electric Aircraft
sources.supports: Installed battery-pack gravimetric energy density must account for thermal, structural and operational safety overhead; a universal cell-to-pack reduction factor is not supported.
sources.application: Require installed usable Wh/kg as a separately sourced input; do not promote cell figures into pack figures.

sources.document: Impact of Technology and Mission Variations on NASA Advanced Air Mobility Concept Vehicles
sources.supports: Concept-aircraft mass and mission sensitivities depend on installed battery usable Wh/kg, rotor and propulsion assumptions, power, thermal system, reserve and mission profile.
sources.application: Compare concept architectures on a shared mission and vary coupled assumptions; do not treat NASA concept numbers as roadable VELTARO performance.

sources.document: Special Condition for VTOL and Means of Compliance
sources.supports: EASA publishes a specific VTOL certification framework and evolving means of compliance.
sources.application: Document applicability with a qualified regulator/certification specialist; not evidence of VELTARO approval.

sources.document: Regulation (EU) 2018/858 on motor-vehicle approval and market surveillance
sources.supports: Regulation defines approval framework and scope for motor vehicles including categories M and N intended for public-road use.
sources.application: Determine possible VELTARO road-vehicle classification separately; do not assume type approval.

open_numeric_evidence.required_conditions: Full installed pack configuration, usable energy window, temperature, age, discharge conditions, hardware mass, source and independent review
Pack-level thermal/electrical test, state of charge, temperature, peak duration, aging and reviewer
Separate structural, road-safety, transformation, propulsion, thermal and avionics mass ledgers
Configuration, flight phase, propulsive performance model and power electronics losses

open_numeric_evidence.parameter: Authorized flight mission and reserve basis
open_numeric_evidence.required_conditions: Country, flight sites, route, airspace, weather, suitable reserve policy and qualified legal/regulatory assessment
